📱 Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean
Keep your Android device running smoothly with Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean, a cleaner app designed for speed, simplicity, and privacy. Quickly clear junk files, remove cached data, manage apps, and keep your photos and videos organized.
🧹 Junk Cleaner
Over time, temporary files and cached data quietly take up space. Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean lets you safely scan, review, and remove unnecessary files, so you can free up room for the content you actually want to keep.
📱 App Manager
With Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean, you can:
● Browse and review all installed apps
● Check storage usage and data consumption per app
● Uninstall apps you no longer need
📸 Photo & Video Cleaner
Duplicate screenshots, old videos, and cluttered media can quickly fill your gallery. Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean makes it easy to:
● Review photos, videos, and documents
● Choose what to keep and what to delete
📂 Large File Finder
Large files take up valuable storage space. Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean helps you:
● See which items are using the most storage
● Decide whether to keep or remove them
🔒 Built-In Privacy Protection
All cleaning and file management happens locally on your device. Turbo Cleaner - Junk Clean never uploads, collects, or shares your personal files. Your data stays with you—private, secure, and always under your control.
